name: nl.klusvang/mcp
title: Klusvang: Dutch building permit counts
description: Counts of Dutch building-permit notices per municipality, province and work type. No key needed.

tools.name: find_municipality
tools.description: Find the URL slug of a Dutch municipality (gemeente) by name, for the other tools. Returns at most 10 matches with their province and the Klusvang page.

name.description: Part of the name, e.g. Den Bosch or Nijmegen.

tools.name: municipality_permit_counts
tools.description: How many building-permit notices (omgevingsvergunningen) one Dutch municipality published recently: the last 60 and 30 days, the 30 days before, new applications, recent grants, a breakdown by work type, and its total and national rank in the latest closed month of the Klusvang bouwmonitor. Counts only: no addresses, names or single permits.

municipality.description: Municipality URL slug, e.g. nijmegen or s-hertogenbosch. Use find_municipality to get it.

work_type.description: Work type, e.g. dakkapel (dormer), aanbouw (extension), kozijnen (window frames).

tools.name: province_permit_counts
tools.description: Building-permit notices in one Dutch province in the last 60 and 30 days, by work type, with the municipalities that published the most. Counts only.

province.description: Province URL slug, e.g. gelderland or noord-holland.

work_type.description: Work type, e.g. dakkapel (dormer), aanbouw (extension), kozijnen (window frames).

tools.name: work_type_nationwide
tools.description: One work type (e.g. dakkapel, aanbouw, kozijnen) across all Dutch municipalities: notices in the last 60 and 30 days, its share and rank among work types, per province, and the municipalities with the most. Counts only.

work_type.description: Work type, e.g. dakkapel (dormer), aanbouw (extension), kozijnen (window frames).

tools.name: bouwmonitor_month
tools.description: The Klusvang bouwmonitor: a frozen monthly count of building-permit notices in the Netherlands, by work type and province, with a ranking of municipalities (optionally for one work type or one province). Without month: the latest closed month. Closed months never change. Counts only.

month.description: YYYY-MM. Default: the latest closed month.

work_type.description: Rank municipalities by this work type.

province.description: Rank only the municipalities of this province.
